name: subfinder
title: Subfinder
description: Passive subdomain enumeration — queries dozens of public sources without touching the target itself. Set SUBFINDER_DOMAIN to an apex domain (no scheme, e.g. faradaysec.com) or use SUBFINDER_DOMAIN_LIST for several. SUBFINDER_SOURCES restricts which providers are used — list (e.g. crtsh, virustotal, alienvault, hackertarget, anubis, threatcrowd). SUBFINDER_RECURSIVE=true expands discovered subdomains.
